fields.why: Education (4 levels) and race/ethnicity (4 groups) are stated to differ under a blanket chi-square across subgroups, an outcome measured per group; age (3 groups) is tabulated.
Education is SES; sex and sexual orientation have only 2 groups each, and state is not an SPD.

'Varied by education level' and 'differed by race/ethnicity' rest on the stated chi-square tests across subgroups (rule 2: omnibus). Age-specific values are only shown in Table 1 with no age claim in the text, so side by side is the better reading for age; the mechanical flag reflects the chi-square on the other entries.

brief_issues: A blanket 'differences across subgroups were tested using chi-squared tests' could be read as covering the age rows too; the brief does not say whether a blanket test statement reaches SPD rows that no text claim discusses.
